package_integrity.basis: Actual loader test hashes all package files before/after and asserts exact equality; real invocation test restores the intentionally modified policy and asserts the full package snapshot unchanged.

observed_side_effects: Legacy and portable plugin skills expose normalized interface, dependency and policy metadata in both full and metadata-only loading. Serialized projection cannot be forged by skill file deserialization.

allow_implicit_invocation=false narrows existing skill admission, including real SkillTool execution even in a full-access request; explicit user selection remains allowed by the existing permission boundary.
Named product restrictions filter skills when this host has no such product identity; changed restrictions invalidate current replay admission.
Unknown top-level agents declarations remain inert. Dependency commands, URLs, requested tools and interface default prompts are never executed or converted into DelegateAgentConfig.
Malformed optional YAML preserves the audited base skill with a sanitized diagnostic; invalid individual dependencies/optional interface fields are dropped without raw content in diagnostics.
Icons resolve only in skill assets or plugin shared assets; missing assets retain a safe lexical path, symlinks and root escape are refused, and all original package bytes are preserved.
intentional_safety_differences: The reference lexically resolves interface assets. This host additionally refuses symlinks and traversal that leaves the plugin root, matching its existing package boundary.

VibeWindow does not impersonate Codex, ChatGPT or Atlas: a nonempty products restriction is not satisfied without a corresponding trusted host identity. No identity/configuration bypass was introduced.

downstream_consumer_observations.behavior: Explicitly mentioned skill dependencies contribute MCP server names to required-server selection. This task retains declarations but does not implement that downstream MCP consumer; tasks 58/66 must review coverage.

Reference MCP dependency installation is additionally gated by is_first_party_originator and SkillMcpDependencyInstall and then policy/user approval. No private first-party identity or automatic installation is copied.
